staticSourceControls.control: Payment signature verification function is present and used by payment verification route.
Webhook signature verification is present and called before webhook handling.
Provider payment amount and currency are compared to expected booking/order values.
Provider signature comparison uses a timing-safe compare in integration layer.
Payment reconciliation function exists for ambiguous or follow-up provider state.
Payment/refund/wallet/ledger/earning/settlement/cash models use fixed-precision Decimal money fields.
Provider webhook event has unique provider/event identity and payload hash to detect event-ID/payload conflict.
Payment/refund/settlement transactions are atomic across business status and ledger effects.
Unknown/timeout provider outcomes are reconciled, not blindly represented as success or failure.
Refund amount cannot exceed refundable captured balance and partial refunds obey a cap.
Commission, tax, fees, driver net earnings, cash collection and settlement use approved formulas.
TEST/demo payment paths cannot produce LIVE financial effects.
Financial adjustments require authorized actor, reason, audit record and immutable traceability.
API replay response does not double-post or reveal sensitive payment/account fields.

nonNegotiableInvariants: Provider/client response alone never confirms a financial transaction; Backend verifies trusted provider status and matching resource/amount/currency.
UNKNOWN or timed-out results remain unknown until reconciliation; do not assume success or create a second payment intent blindly.
A financial side effect is applied at most once for its approved business idempotency scope.
Wallet, ledger and related authoritative state updates must be transactionally consistent.
Captured amount, eligible refund total, commission, driver earnings, cash collection and settlement reconcile under approved formulas.
Money arithmetic uses fixed-precision/decimal-safe handling; no unapproved floating-point money formula is introduced.
No rate, fee, commission, tax, refund window, rounding mode, currency conversion or payout rule is invented by this step.
unresolvedBusinessDecisions: Formal ledger account model and debit/credit balance equations.
Fare/commission/tax/fees rounding policy and supported currency rules.
Refund eligibility, partial refund cap, fee retention and reversal behavior.
Cash collection confirmation and dispute handling.
Payout retries, duplicate provider result, reversal and failed-settlement handling.
Formal TEST-only provider simulation policy and LIVE block conditions.
